mapper.sql: select q.*, u.nickname, u.level_image from question q join user u on q.user_idx = u.idx
mapper.insert: insert into question (user_idx, subject, title, content) values (#{userIdx}, #{subject}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: where q.user_idx = #{userIdx} order by q.written_date desc
mapper.update: update question set status = 1 where idx = #{idx}
mapper.select: select a.*, u.nickname, u.level_image from answer a join user u on a.user_idx = u.idx where a.question_idx = #{questionIdx} order by a.idx limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into answer (user_idx, question_idx, content) values (#{userIdx}, #{questionIdx}, #{content})
